scope: Source records from the supplied 20261103 collection; not a unique or operating-facility census

size.quantity: Largest complete listed antenna-bank geometric aperture
size.formula: max(N * pi * D^2 / 4); never sum bands
size.diameter_unit_basis: Interpret numeric source antenna sizes as dish diameters in metres, consistent with FCC 1.47 m and 1.85 m listings; the KML omits explicit units. No per-site regulatory verification or generic diameter imputation.
size.scope: Listed hardware may be planned, licensed, partially built or retired. Aperture is not throughput, gain, usable bandwidth or installed capacity. Incomplete banks remain flagged.

studies.name: Radial spokes
studies.note: A clipped wheel of rays; different ray counts distinguish capability classes.

studies.name: Concentric rings
studies.note: Concentric circles and broken arcs clipped to each triangle; selected classes use dashed rings.

studies.name: Radial petals
studies.note: Filled tapered petals radiate from the centroid; wider light areas may survive the metallic print better.
